audit.whatIsWrong: The chart reads Skill / Tryndamere / Tryndamere / Skill / Skill / Tryndamere / Tryndamere while all seven whys on the same entry read 'Level 1 favours Darius', 'Level 2 favours Darius', 'Level 3 favours Darius', 'Levels 4-5 favour Tryndamere', 'Level 6 favours Tryndamere', 'First item favours Tryndamere', 'Two-plus items favour Tryndamere'. content.early says 'Darius dominates levels 1-3' and spikes[0] says 'You own levels 1-3'.
audit.why: Five of the seven cells say the opposite of the sentence printed beside them, and the first three are backwards — the chart hands Tryndamere levels 2 and 3, which is the exact window where Battle Fury is empty, Bloodlust has no Fury to consume and Darius has both Crippling Strike and Apprehend. The packet chart is Darius / Darius / Darius / Tryndamere / Tryndamere / Tryndamere / Tryndamere at a 53.75% Darius win rate over 1985 games, matching every why.
audit.corrected: Darius / Darius / Darius / Tryndamere / Tryndamere / Tryndamere / Tryndamere in both layers as one group, with ratings realigned.
sources: internal contradiction with all seven whys, content.early and spikes[0]

audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 6 phase text carries the LaTeX fragment 'R = d + a \times Stacks'. Undying Rage is called a spike that comes 'online' with no cooldown given anywhere, and the first-item spike is credited to 'his spin E'.
audit.why: Undying Rage is 120/100/80 — a rank-1 miss costs him two full minutes, and that number is the entire reason 'force it out first' is the plan. Spinning Slash is 12s falling to 8s and Mocking Shout is 14s; neither is a spike, they are windows. His actual spike is Battle Fury filling the crit bar plus a first crit item.
audit.corrected: Plain-language Level 6 text, Undying Rage's 120s stated, Spinning Slash's 12s and Mocking Shout's 14s written into the cooldown block and the don'ts.

audit.whatIsWrong: The entry credits the crit steroid to E in four places — spikes[0] 'his Fury and E crit-steroid', spikes[2] 'his spin E dodges your E-pull', whys[3] 'Fury and E crit come online', whys[5] 'a crit spike lets his spin dodge E'. breakdown.early says 'he heals through crits'. Mocking Shout is never mentioned anywhere in the matchup.
audit.why: Riot's text: Battle Fury (P) is what 'passively increases his Critical Strike Chance' — Spinning Slash is a targeted 650-range slice with no crit component at all. And he does not heal through crits: Bloodlust 'consume[s] his Fury and heal[s] himself', so crits build the resource and the cast spends it, which is why Grievous Wounds timing works. The real omission is Mocking Shout: an 850-range cry that decreases your Attack Damage and slows you ONLY if your back is turned to him. Against Darius that is both a damage cut on the stat his whole kit rides and a disengage that punishes retreating — face him and it does not slow you at all. None of that reaches the page.
audit.corrected: Crit attributed to Battle Fury, healing attributed to Bloodlust consuming Fury, and Mocking Shout named with its back-turned condition in report[5], phases[5], enemyWin, spikes[2] and content.late.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names only Undying Rage and gives Apprehend 'Long early cooldown' with no number.
audit.why: Three numbers decide every commit here: Undying Rage 120s at rank 1, Spinning Slash 12s falling to 8s — his only escape — and Apprehend 26s falling to 16s. Without them 'bait it, then go' is unactionable.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing says Bloodlust's passive raises his Attack Damage as his health drops.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'increasing his Attack Damage as he is more and more wounded'. A Darius who has bled him to 20% reads that as a finished fight; it is actually the point where Tryndamere hits hardest, and it is why the ult flip works.

notes: Kit-flag false positive: tryndamere.json tags Mocking Shout (W) as a projectile. Riot's description is 'lets out an insulting cry, decreasing surrounding champions' Attack Damage' — an aura-style effect around him, not a travelling missile, so nothing about Wind Wall-class blocking was written in. Undying Rage's duration is not in Riot's Data Dragon text; the entry already says '5s' in several places and I neither added nor removed that claim, but I did not introduce it anywhere new — the rewritten lines say 'while it runs' instead. No tryndamere__darius.json mirror existed when this was written, so nothing was reused and nothing should conflict. breakdown.wave and breakdown.trading carry the shared PDF-extraction run-on seen across this champion's entries; left untouched. diff is the enum 'EVEN' at diffRating 8/10 on a 53.75% Darius win rate — the difficulty pair looks too harsh for a lane the player wins more often than not, but I did not churn it.
